# Every file under docs/ (generated by experiments/generate_file_index.py — do not edit by hand)

Generated by `experiments/generate_file_index.py` on 2026-11-07 at commit de9e925-dirty from git ls-files docs, configs/documentation_registry.json, the repository's Python and shell sources; do not edit by hand.

All 247 files git tracks under `docs/`, by kind. **This is the complete list; [docs/README.md](README.md) is the index of registered *documents* by topic**, and the register covers tracked Markdown only, so the files that are not Markdown appear here and nowhere else.

For a Markdown document the class is the register's, and says how far to trust it as a statement of the current state (`docs/documentation_process.md` defines them). For every other file the last column names the scripts and modules that mention its path. **That search is textual**: it finds a path written whole, in a default argument or a constant, and it does not find one assembled at run time, so an empty cell means no source names the path and not that nothing reads the file.
